title: Sanitize subpath segments in Source::parse to reject '..' traversal
description: Location: src/source/. No equivalent of Vercel's sanitizeSubpath. A malicious source spec like 'owner/repo/../../etc' could escape package root depending on tarball extraction; safety currently depends on extraction step. Fix: in Source::parse for any source accepting subpath, walk path components and bail!() on ParentDir. Reject at parse time, not extraction time. Audit ref: AUDIT.md #12.

title: Expand 'skills remove' to match Vercel: -y, multi-skill, -a, --all, -g, confirm
description: Location: src/cli.rs:223-225. RemoveArgs is currently just { name: String }. Vercel's remove has multi-skill positional, -y, -a, --all, -g, plus a default confirmation prompt. ateam silently destroys cached snapshot + symlinks with no -y to skip a prompt that doesn't exist. Fix: expand RemoveArgs (names: Vec<String>, yes, agents, all, global), add confirmation by default (skip on -y or non-TTY), loop existing single-skill logic. Audit ref: AUDIT.md #7.

title: Resolve GitHub default branch via API instead of hardcoded fallback
description: Location: src/commands/add.rs:110. github::default_branch_fallback() is a hardcoded constant. Repos still on master (or any non-canonical default) silently get the wrong tree fetched when --ref isn't passed. Fix: GET /repos/{owner}/{repo} for default_branch, cache for command duration; fall back to constant only on API failure with a loud warning. Audit ref: AUDIT.md #6.

title: Surface remove_dir_all failures in skills remove instead of swallowing
description: Location: src/commands/remove.rs:54-61. Both snapshot and legacy_cache removals use 'let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(...)'. Permission/IO failures get masked: lockfile says skill is gone, disk still has it. Fix: match the existing pattern at remove.rs:33 — if let Err(e) = ... { ui::warn(...) }, ignoring NotFound. Audit ref: AUDIT.md #5.
close_reason: Surface remove_dir_all failures via ui::warn, ignoring NotFound to handle TOCTOU after exists() check

title: Add file locking on lockfile and manifest
description: Location: src/lockfile.rs, src/manifest.rs (read-modify-write everywhere). Two concurrent ateam skills add runs each load same starting state, upsert their own entry, second write clobbers first. Combined with the silent-sync issue this loses data without warning. Fix: take fs2 exclusive flock on a sibling .lock file for the duration of any mutating command; add --no-wait flag. Audit ref: AUDIT.md #4.

title: Make CacheSlot::commit atomic to prevent TOCTOU on parallel apply
description: Location: src/install.rs:121-138. CacheSlot::commit() does remove_dir_all(final_path) then rename(tmp, final_path). Between the two ops the final path doesn't exist; concurrent ateam apply runs (cron + interactive, etc.) can race and leave dangling symlinks. Fix: three-step atomic swap — rename old to a quarantine name, rename tmp to final, drop the quarantine. Audit ref: AUDIT.md #3.

title: ateam skills add --skill <typo> exits 0 with nothing installed
description: Location: src/commands/add.rs:53-56. When the user passes explicit --skill names that do not resolve, the command prints a warn and returns Ok(()). CI/scripts cannot distinguish 'successfully installed nothing' from 'you typoed the name'. Vercel exits 1. Fix: bail!() when args.skill is non-empty AND nothing matched (keep the 'did you mean' suggestions). Audit ref: AUDIT.md #2.
close_reason: pick_skills now bail!()s when --skill names don't match anything; CI/scripts get exit 1. did-you-mean suggestions preserved. Unit tests cover the bail and partial-match paths.

title: Add --copy mode and --dangerously-accept-openclaw-risks gate
description: Vercel ships --copy for filesystems where symlinks misbehave (Windows, network mounts, some Docker volumes); ateam is symlink-only. Vercel also hard-blocks openclaw/* sources without --dangerously-accept-openclaw-risks. ateam fetches anything. Fix: --copy routes to install_copy instead of install_symlink; add 5-line openclaw block in Source::parse. Audit ref: AUDIT.md #13.

title: Add --json output to 'skills list' and global --quiet
description: Location: src/commands/list.rs, all commands. Vercel ships list --json for editor extensions and dashboards; ateam has only ANSI-colored text. Fix: --json on ListArgs first (define stable schema, version it), then global --quiet to suppress non-error output. Audit ref: AUDIT.md #11.

title: Make 'skills find <query>' work without a TTY
description: Location: src/commands/find.rs:43-58. Non-TTY path exits Ok(()) with a tip and prints nothing. 'ateam skills find foo | head' does nothing — can't grep, can't pipe into editor extensions. Vercel's non-interactive form prints results to stdout. Fix: branch on args.query.is_empty() — non-empty + any context calls registry::search and prints plain stdout. Audit ref: AUDIT.md #10.

title: Add -g, --project, -y to 'skills update'
description: Location: src/cli.rs:217-220. UpdateArgs is just { names: Vec<String> }. Vercel's update has -g, -p, -y plus TTY-or-not autodetect. ateam updates all active entries unconditionally when names is empty; no way to scope or run non-interactively. Fix: add -g, --project <alias>, -y; filter the loop in update.rs:19-27 accordingly. Audit ref: AUDIT.md #8.

title: Make --all imply --skill '*' --agent '*' -y to match Vercel
description: Location: src/cli.rs:168-170. Vercel's --all is a triple-flag override (skill='*', agent='*', -y) for trusted-source bulk install. ateam's --all only sets --skill '*'. Drop-in scripts will hit prompts in non-TTY contexts. Fix: in add.rs, when args.all is set also force args.agents = ['*'] and args.yes = true if not already set. Audit ref: AUDIT.md #9.

title: Warn when lockfile is missing inside a git checkout
description: Location: src/lockfile.rs:86-90. Missing lockfile silently returns empty Lockfile. Inside a fresh git clone this masks 'you forgot to pull'. Fix: when repo is a git checkout AND lockfile is missing, warn with a hint to git pull or ateam apply. Audit ref: AUDIT.md #20.

title: Add --dry-run to 'skills add'
description: apply has --dry-run, add doesn't. Useful for previewing what a multi-skill source will write. Fix: add --dry-run to AddArgs; short-circuit before any fs write. Audit ref: AUDIT.md #19.

title: Add --prefer-claude / --prefer-codex for non-interactive import
description: Location: src/commands/import.rs:381. Non-TTY path bails on CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md divergence with no automation escape. Fix: --prefer-claude / --prefer-codex flags so CI can import without an interactive picker. Audit ref: AUDIT.md #18.

title: Funnel println!/eprintln! through ui::* in activate/deactivate
description: Locations: src/commands/deactivate.rs:39 uses eprintln!; activate.rs:20-22 uses println!; others use ui::*. Inconsistent — hard to grep, breaks future --quiet. Fix: route everything through ui::warn / ui::ok / ui::plain. Audit ref: AUDIT.md #16.

title: Refactor 'find' to invoke add::run via clap-parsed AddArgs
description: Location: src/commands/find.rs:121-132. find constructs AddArgs manually instead of going through clap. Drift risk when AddArgs gains new fields. Fix: build AddArgs through clap's try_parse_from. Audit ref: AUDIT.md #17.

title: Warn when 'list --project <alias>' matches nothing or unknown alias
description: Location: src/commands/list.rs:15-19. --project nonexistent silently lists nothing. User has no way to know if they typoed the alias or there are genuinely no skills. Fix: check alias against MachineConfig::projects, warn if unknown. Audit ref: AUDIT.md #15.

title: Distinguish empty source from clone failure in 'add --list'
description: Location: src/commands/add.rs:38-43. --list on a source with zero skills prints 'Found 0 skills' then nothing. User can't tell if clone succeeded or failed. Fix: when discovered.is_empty(), print 'no skills discovered in this source'. Audit ref: AUDIT.md #14.

title: Replace underscore cursor in 'find' picker with block character
description: Location: src/commands/find.rs:370. Underscore cursor may render oddly on some terminals. Fix: use a block character with reset, or console crate's styling. Audit ref: AUDIT.md #25.

title: Verify NO_COLOR env handling for banner gradient
description: Location: src/cli.rs:28-43. Banner only checks console::colors_enabled(); console crate already supports NO_COLOR but verify nothing bypasses it. Fix: add a NO_COLOR=1 test or document the assumption. Audit ref: AUDIT.md #24.

title: Delete dead _unused() function in init.rs
description: Location: src/commands/init.rs:262-265. #[allow(dead_code)] _unused() with no documented reason. Fix: delete. Audit ref: AUDIT.md #23.

title: Use nanosecond precision in install::backup_path suffix
description: Location: src/install.rs:69. Backup suffix is unix-seconds; same-second collisions possible. Fix: use nanos or atomic counter. Audit ref: AUDIT.md #22.

title: Format profile list with ', ' instead of ','
description: Location: src/commands/list.rs:46. profiles joined with ',' not ', '. Fix: join(', '). Audit ref: AUDIT.md #21.
